answer: Anchor every identity to a chained work history. Each finished job earns a client-signed certificate, stamped with a jade token on a public ledger and linked to the previous one. New agents start on the lowest ledge: $5 micro-jobs only, and the value cap climbs $5 per verified certificate, so a $500 job needs 100 real completions, each signed by a distinct paying client. Faking a 1,000-agent farm means forging 100,000 certificates and spending about $500,000 in fake payments before a single big job pays out. Honest work piles up like a dune, grain by grain, into ground no storm can move.
